data.long_description:
Mulberry at Dubai Hills Estate is a mid-rise residential development by Emaar offering 1- to 4-bedroom apartments with views of Dubai Hills Park. Completed and ready to move in, Mulberry consists of two clusters of low-rise buildings designed with spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and modern finishes.

 The project is set directly along the 18,000 sq. m Dubai Hills Park, giving residents immediate access to green spaces, jogging tracks, cycling routes, and family-friendly recreation. Amenities include swimming pools, fully equipped gyms, landscaped podiums, and children’s play areas, with retail and dining available at the nearby Dubai Hills Mall. Strategically located along Al Khail Road, Mulberry provides quick connectivity to Downtown Dubai (10 minutes) and Dubai Marina (15 minutes), while also being close to international schools and the Dubai Hills Golf Club.
